prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Paint one production panoramic 25:8 character portrait background for the fictional merchant republic of Zewggad on Odedza island at the mouth of the Marenica Sea. REMAKE with a new composition; do not reproduce the previous pretty hilltop city. Image 1 (original game hall) is brushwork reference ONLY: economical rough matte paint, broken shapes, lost edges, soft smoky distance, muted colors. Image 2 is exact heraldry reference ONLY. Scene: from street level beside a shut waterfront counting-house at the edge of a cramped mercantile quay, look diagonally along irregular docks toward a LOW fortified acropolis on a rocky headland at far right. Only a few compact civic roofs inside its walls, no cathedral or soaring fantasy citadel. The middle distance is a physically plausible working port: squat plaster-and-rubble warehouses built and repaired at different times, dark timber shutters, patched ochre and faded red market awnings, sheltered wooden oared merchant ships with bundled sails, stout mooring posts. A recognizable causeway winds from quay toward the modest acropolis. Grey-green choppy sea at middle-left, salt-stained dark masonry and weathered timber. Overcast marine daylight with a single restrained pale light patch on a market roof, no glorious sun rays or resort-blue water. Quiet shadowed LEFTMOST quarter is the plain side wall and closed shutter of a counting-house, with one rope coil at its foot; useful portrait space without an arch or terrace. A single small worn white pennant on a civic pole at right uses the reference's winged gold lion carrying the small red-sailed ship; keep it small and paint simplified recognizable shapes, not a giant foreground flag. Wealth should come from density of practical trade infrastructure, not grand ornamental architecture. Broad visible irregular brush marks, simplified roof masses, deliberately leave unimportant areas unresolved. Details must read at 800x256. No people, readable writing, UI, watermark, marble colonnade, foreground decorative parapet, potted plants, cypress-lined fairy-tale hill, repetitive arches, identical windows, filigree, giant statues, huge city sprawl, glossy hyperdetail, photographic surfaces, or recognizable real-world landmark. Concrete believable joins and ship rigging, few carefully chosen structures rather than hundreds of tiny invented buildings.
visual_review: Inspected full-size: weathered working port, coherent low acropolis, muted marine light and simplified painted surfaces. Native preview checked during runtime build.
